title: Ukholo Olufihliwe Ngaphakathi Kwezindonga Zesigodlo
intro: Enkabeni yenkantolo enonya egcwele amacebo nokuziqhenya, umphefumulo oyedwa uphethe imfihlo eyingozi. Izungezwe amandla nezinsongo zokufa, le nceku ka-Allah ibuka isithunywa simi sodwa silwa nombuso. Lapho ukuthula kuba ukuhlanganyela, kufanele kwenziwe isinqumo esinesibindi sokukhuluma iqiniso ngengozi enkulu yomuntu siqu.
clues: Ngangihlala phakathi kwabantu abanamandla nabaqhoshayo ababenqaba izibonakaliso zika-Allah.
Ngafihla ukholo lwami okwesikhashana ngenkathi labo ababengizungezile beceba isithunywa.
Ngakhuluma obala, ngathi: Uyambulala umuntu ngoba ethi, iNkosi yami ingu-Allah, kuyilapho ubufakazi obucacile bufikile?
Ngaxwayisa abantu bami ngekusasa lezizwe zangaphambilini nangoSuku Lokubizana.
Ngabatshela ukuthi umbusi engangimkhonza ubonisa umbono omncane kuphela, kodwa ukuphila kwangemva kokufa kuyikhaya langempela.
Ngathi: O bantu bami, ngilandeleni futhi ngizoniqondisa endleleni eqondile, futhi u-Allah wangisindisa ebubini becebo labo.

trial.label: Ngenzeni?
options: Ingcebo eqoqwe okhiye bayo babethwala amadoda anamandla
Wakha umbhoshongo ophakeme ukuze abuke unkulunkulu kaMose
Ukholo olufihliwe lwabe seluvikela uMose obala futhi lwaxwayisa abantu bami
Wakha ithole legolide elenza umsindo wokukhala
Wavimba indlela yoMprofethi futhi wahlekisa ngesambulo ngenxa yengcebo
trial.answer: Ukholo olufihliwe lwabe seluvikela uMose obala futhi lwaxwayisa abantu bami

outcome.label: Ube Yini Umphumela Wami?
options: Ngaminza kanye nebutho olwandle oluhlukene phakathi

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
